name: com.nova.animation
description: Unity's Animator: state machines with parameters and transitions (Animator Controller assets and the Animator window), Blend Trees (1D / 2D), root motion, and Humanoid retargeting so clips made for one skeleton play on another. Procedural animation components: Legs Animator (feet stay on uneven ground, planted feet lock, hips follow, body leans on slopes), Hands Animator (hand IK to grips and walls) and Look Animator (head, neck and spine turn toward a target) and Dynamic Bone (hair, skirts, tails and straps sway with movement, gravity and wind and bounce off sphere / capsule colliders — VRM Spring Bones are imported automatically) and Expressions (named facial expressions made of blend shapes - happy, angry, sad, mouth shapes aa ih ou ee oh - with automatic blinking; VRM expressions are imported automatically). C#: Animator.SetFloat / Play / CrossFade / applyRootMotion, LegsAnimator, HandsAnimator.SetIKPosition, LookAnimator. Included in new projects by default.
